card.name: Linking words before clotting tests
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "the", "as" or a comma that come just before the name of a coagulation test (whole blood clotting time, INR, Factor Xa) in heparin and anticoagulant monitoring text.

modes.label: Before a clotting test name
modes.description: The word "the" or "as" sits right before a named coagulation test.
modes.example: when<< the>> whole blood clotting time is elevated approximately

modes.label: In a list of tests
modes.description: A comma or "the" in a list of coagulation measures such as aPTT, INR and PT.
modes.example: (aPTT, INR<<,>> platelet count) at baseline and continue
